items.title: Every proper modification that is an isomorphism over a dense open is dominated by an admissible blow-up
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: For B quasi-compact quasi-separated, U quasi-compact open, and f : X -> B proper with f^{-1}U -> U an isomorphism, the lemma produces a U-admissible blow-up B' -> B together with a factorization B' -> X -> B — the domination-of-modifications principle driving approximation theorems. The retained proof is written: the chapter's isomorphism-after-blowing-up lemma (lemma isomorphism-after-blowing-up, published chapter content) supplies a U-admissible blow-up whose strict transform X' maps isomorphically onto B'; the inverse isomorphism B' = X' followed by the canonical X' -> X provides the required factorization, each arrow named. Retained author proof at lines 9018-9022.
